title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:8:0:00009:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 8 (Non-Disclosure of Appraisal Materials, etc.)
(1) Performance appraisal materials shall not be disclosed; provided, the President of the Constitutional Court may, where deemed necessary, inform the person subject to appraisal of a summary of the appraisal results for the relevant year.
(2) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), a person subject to appraisal may apply to be informed of a summary of the appraisal results within a period determined by the President of the Constitutional Court.
(3) The President of the Constitutional Court shall inform a person who applies under paragraph (2) of a summary of the appraisal results if the person falls under either of the following:
1. The appraisal results for the relevant year are markedly poor;
2. The accumulated appraisal results are poor.
(4) A person who has been informed of a summary of the appraisal results shall not disclose whether that information was provided or its contents.
